description_en: Tests whether the network and authentication information of a data source are available
description_zh: 测试数据源的网络和认证信息是否可用
name: TestAgenticDataSourceConnection

parameters.help_en:
The source of the data source. Valid values:
RDS: ApsaraDB instance.
PUBLIC_OWN: self-managed database connected over the Internet.
ECS_OWN: self-managed database hosted on an ECS instance.
GATEWAY: database connected through Database Gateway.
VPC_IDC: database connected over a VPC or data center
parameters.help_zh: 数据源来源。取值：RDS-云数据库实例，PUBLIC_OWN-公网自建数据库，ECS_OWN-ECS 自建数据库，GATEWAY-通过数据库网关接入，VPC_IDC-专有网络或 IDC 接入
parameters.name: instance_source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud resource instance. This parameter is required when you select an existing cloud instance. You can leave this parameter empty when you enter a connection endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 选择已有云实例时填写云资源实例 ID；按连接地址录入时可不填
parameters.name: instance_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The alias. You can leave this parameter empty when testing a connection. This parameter does not create or modify a data source
parameters.help_zh: 测试连接时可不填，不会创建或修改数据源
parameters.name: alias

parameters.help_en: The catalog name. You can leave this parameter empty when testing a connection. This parameter does not create a metadata catalog
parameters.help_zh: 测试连接时可不填，不会创建元数据目录
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Use uppercase letters. Do not pass numbers. Valid values: MYSQL, POSTGRESQL, ORACLE, SQLSERVER, MARIADB, POLARDB, POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, POLARDB_ORACLE, OCEANBASEX, DRDS, ADB_MYSQL, ADB_POSTGRESQL, CLICKHOUSE, SELECTDB, STARROCKS, HOLOGRES, MAXCOMPUTE, ES_REST, and TRINO
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型，使用大写标识，不要传数字。当前支持：MYSQL、POSTGRESQL、ORACLE、SQLSERVER、MARIADB、POLARDB、POLARDB_POSTGRESQL、POLARDB_ORACLE、OCEANBASEX、DRDS、ADB_MYSQL、ADB_POSTGRESQL、CLICKHOUSE、SELECTDB、STARROCKS、HOLOGRES、MAXCOMPUTE、ES_REST、TRINO
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The domain name or IP address of the database. Do not include the protocol, path, or port. This parameter is optional. You can leave this parameter empty when you select an existing cloud instance and the endpoint is automatically populated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。数据库域名或 IP，不包含协议、路径和端口；选择已有云实例且地址已自动带出时可不填
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The service port of the database. This parameter is optional. You can leave this parameter empty when you select an existing cloud instance and the port is automatically populated
parameters.help_zh: 可选。数据库服务端口；选择已有云实例且端口已自动带出时可不填
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The schema name. This parameter is optional. For ADB_POSTGRESQL, DRDS, POSTGRESQL, and POLARDB_POSTGRESQL, enter the database name. For ORACLE, enter the SID or service name, and prefix the service name with a forward slash (/). For POLARDB_ORACLE, enter the SID. For MAXCOMPUTE, enter the project name. Leave this parameter empty for other types
parameters.help_zh: 可选。ADB_POSTGRESQL、DRDS、POSTGRESQL、POLARDB_POSTGRESQL 填数据库名；ORACLE 填 SID 或服务名，服务名前加 /；POLARDB_ORACLE 填 SID；MAXCOMPUTE 填 Project；其他类型不填
parameters.name: schema

parameters.help_en: The name of the Snowflake compute warehouse. This parameter takes effect only when DbType is set to SNOWFLAKE
parameters.help_zh: Snowflake 计算仓库名称，仅 DbType=SNOWFLAKE 生效
parameters.name: snowflake_warehouse

parameters.help_en: The name of the Snowflake role. This parameter takes effect only when DbType is set to SNOWFLAKE
parameters.help_zh: Snowflake 角色名称，仅 DbType=SNOWFLAKE 生效
parameters.name: snowflake_role

parameters.help_en: The authentication type. This parameter is optional. Valid values: -1 (no authentication required), 0 (username and password), 1 (password only), and 2 (password-free)
parameters.help_zh: 可选。取值：-1-无需认证，0-用户名和密码，1-仅密码，2-免密
parameters.name: auth_type

parameters.help_en: The logon username. You can leave this parameter empty for authentication methods that do not require a username
parameters.help_zh: 登录用户名；无需用户名的认证方式可不填
parameters.name: auth_account

parameters.help_en: The logon password. When testing an existing data source, you can leave this parameter empty to reuse the saved password. If a new value is passed, the new value takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 登录密码；测试已有数据源时可不填以沿用已保存的密码，传入新值时优先使用本次值
parameters.name: auth_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL. Valid values:
1: Enable.
0: Disable.
-1: Use the default setting.
SSL is supported only for ADB_MYSQL, CLICKHOUSE, MARIADB, MYSQL, OCEANBASEX, POLARDB, SELECTDB, and STARROCKS. Leave this parameter empty for other types
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用 SSL：1-启用，0-关闭，-1-使用默认设置。仅 ADB_MYSQL、CLICKHOUSE、MARIADB、MYSQL、OCEANBASEX、POLARDB、SELECTDB、STARROCKS 支持 SSL，其他类型不填
parameters.name: use_ssl

parameters.help_en: The complete ARN of the RAM role. This parameter is required when you use an Alibaba Cloud RAM role to access the data source. Leave this parameter empty in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 使用阿里云 RAM 角色访问数据源时填写完整角色 ARN；其他场景不填
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en: The name of the KMS secret. This parameter is required when you use KMS to manage database credentials. Leave this parameter empty in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 使用 KMS 托管数据库凭据时填写凭据名称；其他场景不填
parameters.name: kms_secret

parameters.help_en: The environment type. This parameter is optional when testing a connection. Valid values: product, pre, dev, test, sit, uat, pet, and stag
parameters.help_zh: 测试连接时可不填。取值：product、pre、dev、test、sit、uat、pet、stag
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize the alias. This parameter is optional when testing a connection. This parameter does not modify the data source name
parameters.help_zh: 测试连接时可不填，不会修改数据源名称
parameters.name: sync_alias

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the data source. This parameter is required when testing an existing data source. If no new password is passed, the saved password is reused. Leave this parameter empty when testing a new data source
parameters.help_zh: 测试已有数据源时填写其 UUID；若未传新密码，将沿用已保存的密码。测试新数据源时不填
parameters.name: data_source_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC. This parameter is required when you access MaxCompute over a VPC. Leave this parameter empty in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 通过专有网络访问 MaxCompute 时填写目标 VPC ID；其他场景不填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. This parameter is required when you access MaxCompute over a VPC. Leave this parameter empty in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 通过专有网络访问 MaxCompute 时填写目标可用区 ID；其他场景不填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is required when you access MaxCompute over a VPC. Leave this parameter empty in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 通过专有网络访问 MaxCompute 时填写目标交换机 ID；其他场景不填
parameters.name: vswitch_id

Message.description_en: The description of the connection test result. This parameter is usually empty when the connection is successful, and returns the cause when the connection fails
Message.description_zh: 连接测试结果说明；连接成功时通常为空，失败时返回原因
Message.example: 连接超时，请检查连接地址。

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the data source is connected

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails. This parameter is empty when the call is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误码；成功时为空

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails. This parameter is empty when the call is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的错误信息；成功时为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the current call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the current call is successful
